Refs #354 — `claudinite-growth/rule-revalidation` run over this repo's local pack scope (`.claudinite/local/packs`, the `claudinite-growth.pack_paths` default; the only pack under it is `local/canary`).

## Round 1 — every claim probed

**Stale (corrected):** the settings-file name. `RULES.md`, `SKILL.md` (×2), `pack.mjs`'s header comment, and `pack-intact.mjs`'s two finding-text strings all said `local/canary` is declared in `.claudinite-checks.json`. Probe: read the currently-vendored `.claudinite/shared/engine/settings-file-names.mjs`, which documents THE RENAME (#1252) — `.claudinite-settings.json` is the current `SETTINGS_FILE`; `.claudinite-checks.json` is `LEGACY_SETTINGS_FILE`, retired from all writes and due full removal at #1640 — and confirmed this repo's own tracked declaration file is in fact `.claudinite-settings.json` (`.claudinite-checks.json` doesn't exist here). Corrected every reference to the current name.

**Holds (`RULES-1` / `canary-role-1`, marked workaround entries — canon #555):** "this pack exists to keep [a local pack's manifest parse, its rule dispatch in both scopes, and its skill mounting] loading for real." Probe: read `.claudinite/shared/engine/selftest.mjs` — `probePackManifests` (the #555 probe) and `probeSkillLinks` (the #424 probe, for dangling skill mounts) are both still live in the current vendored engine, and `pack-shape.mjs` still separately asserts the two-scope-dispatch-plus-skill-mounting shape against disk. The fleet still depends on exactly this combination; not a retirement candidate.

**Holds (`canary-role-2`, marked workaround entry — canon #328):** vendoring's anti-rewind guard refuses to rewind the stamped `ref` past a non-ancestor sha, landing `ref-not-on-trunk`. Probe: the guard's own implementation is not vendored into a member's mount (it runs from a fresh canon clone at convergence time, per `claudinite-lifecycle/tasks/update/worker.mjs`'s own comment), so this session cannot execute it directly — but that same currently-vendored worker.mjs still names "the next converge's anti-rewind guard" and the identical failure mode ("wedges its own canary") in its own comments, corroborating the claim's mechanics from live canon content. Left as-is; a stronger probe would need canon-repo reach this session doesn't have.

**Holds:** `mount-present.mjs`'s fix text ("run the canon's vendoring/`apply-vendor-set.mjs` against this repo"). Probe: `apply-vendor-set.mjs` is still named at that path in the current `engine/version.mjs`, `engine/converge-wiring.mjs`, and two canon skill docs (`adopt-claudinite`, `adopt-pack`).

**Holds:** `realism-artifacts.mjs`'s required-artifact list (`.claude/settings.json`, the scheduler and conformance workflow paths) and its fix text ("re-running the canon's adoption/converge-wiring"). Probe: all three paths exist in this repo at HEAD; `converge-wiring.mjs` exists in the current vendored engine.

**Holds:** `pack-intact.mjs`'s claim that a missing manifest "raises a blocking config error" at load. Probe: `pack-registry.mjs` still reports a blocking `config`-rule finding on an unvalidated manifest.

No claims were left `unprobed` outright — the two canon-side workaround entries got what read-only evidence this session's vendored mount could offer, short of reaching the canon repo itself.

## A pre-existing blocking finding, fixed in the same branch

Landing this PR's own commit tripped the work-scope `reference-integrity` check on something unrelated: `README.md`'s generated pack-badge row still carried a `barriers` entry with no badge file behind it — stale from before this branch (byte-identical to `origin/main`), left over from a pack rename this repo's `.claudinite-settings.json` no longer names, and missing the `claudinite-tasks` badge that declaration does carry. Regenerated the row with `converge-wiring.mjs`'s own `badgeRowEntries`/`convergeBadgeRow` (never hand-edited the generated block) so the branch stays green.

- `node .claudinite/shared/engine/checks/check_the_world.mjs` — 0 blocking, 0 advisory
- `node .claudinite/shared/engine/checks/check_the_work.mjs` — 0 blocking, 0 advisory
